resources.name: Cantera (open-source chemical kinetics and thermodynamics library)
resources.notes: Cantera provides Gibbs free energy minimization via its equilibrium solver.

resources.name: Thermochemical database for gas and condensed species

access.notes: The Burcat thermodynamic database contains NASA-7 polynomial coefficients for many species. Additional data for solids (SiC, Si3N4, BN, B4C, graphite) may be combined from NIST-JANAF.

resources.notes: The agent must assemble thermochemical data covering all species in the SiCl3CH3-BCl3-NH3-H2-Ar system, including condensed phases SiC, Si3N4, BN, B4C, C.
